caption: The drawing shows two views, front and back, of a single female figure standing on a brown oval mat with a red border. The woman is wearing a full-length, off-white dress with lace trim at the hem and sleeves, and a matching off-white shawl draped around her shoulders. She has a blue sash tied at her waist with a bow on her right hip. Her sleeves are three-quarter length, and her shoes are off-white. There is a reddish band or marking on her upper arm. The woman's long, black hair is parted in the middle and falls down her back. In the back view, a long, dark blue or black ribbon or sash hangs from her waist to the hem of her dress. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Doll
